ENCE (known as ENCE eSports prior to 2018) is a Finnish professional esports organization.

  • April 13th - ENCE eSports is founded. They enter Counter-Strike: Global Offensive with the signing of TOOMUCHVIDEOGAMES, a roster consisting of: shaker, SAGGERTON, mkzz, suNny, and dRiim. [1]
  • May 2nd - aslak replaces SAGGERTON.
  • May 21st - ENCE eSports dismiss their team due to internal problems. [2]
  • September 12th - ENCE eSports sign 4w: natu, allu, suNny, reVicer and xartE. [3]
  • October 8th - ENCE eSports replace reVicer with naSu. [4]
  • February 5th - aslak replaces naSu. [5]
  • February 15th - reflex replaces KHRN. [6]
  • March 6th - reflex leaves ENCE eSports to join minttu. [7]
  • March 7th - ENCE eSports release aslak and add jOELZ and disturbed. [8]
  • March 24th - ScurK replaces jOELZ. [9]
  • May 15th - suNny leaves ENCE eSports. [10]
  • June 30th - ENCE eSports cease operations and release their Global Offensive team. [11]
  • January 4th - ENCE eSports announce their return by signing allu and the core of MIXCAT: stonde, suNny, juho and xartE. [12]
  • May 22nd - naSu, who stood in for stonde at DH Tours 2016, replaces him in the starting lineup on a tryout basis. [13]
  • August 16th - allu is acquired by FaZe Clan. [14]
  • August 30th - ENCE eSports release xartE and acquire Aleksib and arvid from Findictus and SkitLite Gaming, respectively. [15]
  • October 30th - Juhob steps down from the roster. [16][17]
  • December 1st - ENCE eSports part ways with their remaining players. [18]
  • February 16th - ENCE eSports announce their new 2017 line-up consisting arvid, Leaf, Joel B, ociriz, and rEplan. [19]
  • June 20th - ENCE eSports release their line-up. [20]
  • March 12th - ENCE eSports announce that they have signed a 2-year long contract with allu, as well as a partnership with Finnish hockey club Lahden Pelicans. [21]
  • April 1st - ENCE eSports rename to ENCE. [22]
  • April 4th - ENCE finalize their lineup with the signings of Aleksib, sergej, Aerial, and xseveN. [23]
  • August 23rd - ENCE sign Twista as the head coach. [24]
  • August 23rd - ENCE sign suNny to replace Aleksib, who will be benched after the StarLadder Major. [25]
  • December 4th - Aleksib is acquired by OG. [26][27]
  • April 21st - ENCE sign Jamppi. [28]
  • August 7th - xseveN is acquired by HAVU Gaming. [29]
  • September 11th - ENCE suspend Twista pending an investigation into his usage of the coach bug during his time at iGame.com. [30]
  • September 30th - Twista is moved to an analyst position. [31]
  • October 22nd - Aerial steps down from the active roster and goes on medical leave. [32]
  • November 5th - ENCE acquire doto and sAw from HAVU Gaming, the latter as head coach, on a two-year contract. [33]
  • November 17th - sergej steps down from ENCE's active roster, citing motivation problems. [34]
  • December 22nd - suNny is benched from ENCE's starting lineup by mutual agreement. [35]
  • January 1st - Aerial is acquired by HAVU Gaming. ENCE acquire SADDYX from SJ Gaming. [36][37][38]
  • January 18th - ENCE part ways with Twista. [39]
  • January 21st - ENCE bench Jamppi and SADDYX; they acquire Snappi and Spinx from c0ntact Gaming and dycha from Sprout to complete their roster. [40]
  • February 19th - ENCE terminate suNny's contract by mutual agreement and he leaves the team. [41]
  • February 25th - Jamppi is acquired by Team Liquid's VALORANT division after announcing his retirement from competitive Global Offensive earlier in the year. [42][43]
  • April 8th - ENCE terminate SADDYX's contract by mutual agreement and he leaves the team. [44]
  • April 12th - sergej is acquired by an undisclosed team. [45]
  • May 1st - LOMME joins as the team's analyst. [46]
  • May 12th - allu takes a leave of absence from ENCE due to personal reasons. [47]
  • June 17th - ENCE sign hades. [48]
  • November 22nd - LOMME is acquired by Astralis. [49]
  • December 2nd - ENCE acquire trochu from Dr. Pepper Team as an analyst. [50]
  • January 7th - ENCE bench doto. [51]
  • January 21st - ENCE acquire maden from FunPlus Phoenix. [52]
  • February 2nd - ENCE release doto. [53]
  • March 5th - Snappi, dycha, and Spinx sign a two-year contract extension with ENCE, keeping them tied to the organization until the end of 2023. [54]
  • May 10th - hades signs a two-year contract extension with ENCE, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2023. [55]
  • August 3rd - allu is acquired by JANO Esports. [56]
  • August 5th - ENCE bench hades. [57]
  • August 15th - Spinx is acquired by Team Vitality. [58]
  • August 20th - ENCE sign SunPayus and acquire valde from OG. [59]
  • August 29th - ENCE loan hades to Team Finest until the end of November. [60]
  • October 6th - hades returns to ENCE's bench after Team Finest cease operations. [61]
  • December 22nd - ENCE terminate hades' contract by mutual agreement and he leaves the team. [62]
  • February 14th - ENCE bench valde. [63]
  • February 16th - ENCE acquire NertZ from Endpoint. [64]
  • August 29th - valde is acquired by TSM. [65]
  • November 26th - ENCE part ways with Snappi and sAw. [66]
  • November 27th - ENCE sign gla1ve and kuben, the latter as coach. [67]
  • December 16th - maden and SunPayus are acquired by Team Falcons. [68]
  • December 17th - ENCE acquire Goofy, Kylar and hades from 9INE. Additionally, NertZ is acquired by Heroic. [69][70]
  • February 9th - dycha signs a contract extension with ENCE. [71]
  • March 27th - ENCE part ways with trochu. [72]
  • May 29th - ENCE bench dycha and hades and sign sdy and promote podi from the academy team. [73]
  • June 14th - ENCE sign Fisic0 as their new analyst. [74]
  • July 10th - dycha and hades are acquired by Monte. [75]
  • August 31st - ENCE bench kuben. [76]
  • September 9th - ENCE acquire enkay J from Entropiq as their new coach. [77]
  • September 19th - ENCE terminate Goofy's contract by mutual agreement and he leaves the team. [78]
  • October 11th - ENCE bench Kylar, acquire xKacpersky from Young Ninjas, and sign Neityu. [79]
  • March 31st - ENCE release Kylar. [80]
  • July 10th - ENCE loan xKacpersky to Ninjas in Pyjamas and promote myltsi from the academy team. [81]
  • July 24th - ENCE bench gla1ve and sign rigoN as his replacement. [82]
  • October 17th - ENCE release kuben. [83]
  • December 18th - ENCE release gla1ve. [84]
  • January 6th - ENCE part ways with myltsi and rigoN, and sign F1KU and kRaSnaL as their replacements. [85][86]
  • March 11th - ENCE bench and transfer-list their roster. [87]
  • April 1st - xKacpersky is acquired by Ninjas in Pyjamas on a permanent basis as ENCE sign HENU and promote their academy team, a roster consisting of teme, millert, Schwarz, Cliqq, and Whitey, the latter as coach, for an interim period. [88][89]
  • April 11th - ENCE part ways with Fisic0 following the expiration of his contract. [90]
  • April 16th - enkay J is acquired by FaZe Clan. [91]
  • May 7th - F1KU is acquired by Metizport. [92]
  • June 5th - ENCE part ways with Whitey. [93]
  • June 9th - ENCE sign allu as the team's coach. [94]
  • June 30th - ENCE part ways with sdy following the expiration of his contract. [95]
  • July 14th - podi is acquired by FOKUS. [96]
  • August 11th - Neityu is acquired by FaZe Clan. [97]
  • August 13th - ENCE bench Cliqq and add joeski on a trial basis. [98]
  • September 3rd - ENCE release Cliqq. [99]
